title: flaky: DatasetReportRenderer comparePrevious-36645 asserts the compared row before the previous-period rows arrive
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (a new failure signature in the merge queue, unrelated to the ejected PR) · Source: fleet (merge-group CI run 46019741713, job `Test UI (8/16)`, PR #37989)

## What happens

`ui/packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/DatasetReportRenderer.comparePrevious-36645.test.tsx:159` failed once in the merge queue:

```
AssertionError: expected { stage: 'Won', amount: 30 } to match object { amount: 30, amount__compare: 20 }
```

The series assertions just above it passed (`amount__compare` with its label and `variant: 'comparison'`), so the chart had the compare series but not yet the previous period's rows. The test reads `chartProps.schema.data` synchronously after that, with no wait. The ejected PR (#37989) touches only a tool-name registry and locale labels.

## Expected

- [ ] The test waits for the compared row (for example `await waitFor(() => expect(won).toMatchObject(...))`), or the renderer is shown to publish series and rows together and the race is elsewhere; say which.
- [ ] If the renderer can draw a compare series with no compare values for a moment, say whether a user sees an empty comparison flash.

Grade: area:ux · tests · reach: one UI test, merge-queue ejections · evidence: the run above, one occurrence
Suggested-grade: p3
Size: XS
Related: #36645, PR #37989.
